content: LB health checks: split liveness (/healthz - process alive only, <50ms, no dependency checks, never 503 on dependency blips) from readiness (/readyz - checks critical deps, 200 only when all pass, else 503 so LB drains traffic). 200=healthy, 503=unhealthy, 500=checker bug, avoid 429/4xx. LBs key off status code, NOT body - body is for humans/dashboards (safe: status string, service, version, timestamp; never expose dep hosts/internal detail). No IETF body standard (draft health+json expired 2022). Two-tier pattern: minimal public probe + auth-gated /details. Probes poll every ~10-15s, keep total check <5s, per-dep timeout 100-300ms, cache readiness results 2-10s, include_in_schema=False. Uptime-seconds is informational only, not consumed by LBs.
